method: ATGLK2I00<pp> read of I/O ports 0x00..0x7f, three passes idle, three passes during AT&T8 analogue loopback with self-test, two passes after AT&T0
writes: none; every command sent was a read, AT, ATI7, ATS18=0 (already 0), AT&T8, AT&T0
self_test_result: 000 errors, so the modulator/analogue/demodulator path ran
finding: Only 0x18, 0x1a, 0x1c and 0x1e differ between idle and active audio, and all four are mailbox handshake/status registers. No CPU I/O port carries audio samples.
limits: A sweep takes seconds, so it cannot resolve a 9.6 kHz signal; it establishes which ports change state, not their waveform.
Ports are read one at a time and are not sampled simultaneously.
Absence of change in a port is not proof it is unrelated to audio, only that it holds no host-visible sample.
